suñña: [ suna + ya. Sunassa hitaṃ suññaṃ, yo, nyassa ñño, suna gatiyaṃ vā, yo. Dhāna, ṭī. 698. Suna + ya. Sunāya pāṇi-vadhāya hitaṃ rahassaṭṭhānattāti suññaṃ. Thoma. Atisayena uīno suñño, abhāvavisiṭṭho. Kappadduma. ၐūnya-saṃ. Suṇṇa, sunna-prā, addhamāgadhī. Suñña 25-myiuḥ, paṭisaṃ. 359-66-krañña့. ]  CL=9 (1) (A) absence- lack- of people (B) absence of atta - self. (2) lack of essence. (m) (3) suññakappa, an aeon in which no Bnddha appears. (nt.)
